pacifist.scoring_rule_1: تحصل على النقاط فقط للبقاء على قيد الحياة
pacifist.scoring_rule_2: 0.25 نقطة عن كل جندي (كبير) على اللوح
pacifist.scoring_rule_3: 0.5 نقطة مقابل كل فارِس أو راهب أو رخ على اللوح
pacifist.scoring_rule_4: +0.7 points for every (big) knight, bishop, rook on the board
pacifist.scoring_rule_5: +1.25 points for every (big) queen on the board

knightmare.scoring_rule_1: +1 point for every turn on the field

strategist.scoring_rule_1: Pieces will move in order rather than simultaneously
strategist.scoring_rule_2: +1 point for every turn on the field
strategist.scoring_rule_5: +3 points for every knight, bishop, rook taken

drunk.scoring_rule_1: +1 point for every turn on the field
drunk.scoring_rule_4: +3 points for every knight, bishop, rook taken

arcade.scoring_rule_1: +1 point for every 2.5 seconds on the field (the timer for the pieces moving)
arcade.scoring_rule_4: +3 points for every knight, bishop, rook taken

loop.scoring_rule_1: +1 point for every turn on the field
loop.scoring_rule_4: +3 points for every knight, bishop, rook taken
